variables.name: LP_HOME
variables.description: Optional application data directory override; blank uses the platform default.

variables.name: LP_BIND
variables.description: Daemon bind address; loopback is the safe native default.

variables.name: LP_IN_CONTAINER
variables.description: Set to 1 only for the explicitly containerized runtime.

variables.name: LP_DATA_POLICY
variables.description: Default data-egress policy for later provider routing.

variables.name: LP_BUDGET_DAY
variables.description: Neutral daily hosted-spend cap in the configured currency.

variables.name: LP_BUDGET_PROJECT
variables.description: Neutral project hosted-spend cap in the configured currency.

variables.name: LP_GODOT_BIN
variables.description: Optional path to a verified Godot executable.

variables.name: LP_BLENDER_BIN
variables.description: Optional path to a verified Blender executable.

variables.name: LP_FFMPEG_BIN
variables.description: Optional path to a verified ffmpeg executable.

variables.name: LP_LLAMA_SERVER_BIN
variables.description: Optional path to a verified llama-server executable.

variables.name: LP_COMFYUI_URL
variables.description: Optional local ComfyUI endpoint; blank disables the route.

variables.name: LP_KEY_PROVIDER_EXAMPLE
variables.description: Example provider secret; leave empty and use the OS keychain later.

variables.name: LP_TEST_NETWORK_GUARD
variables.description: Enable the offline test network guard.

variables.name: LP_LIVE_TESTS
variables.description: Opt in to tests requiring external agents or hosted providers.

variables.name: LP_HW_TESTS
variables.description: Opt in to hardware qualification tests.
